Baloch separatists claim deadly attack on Pakistan coast guard

The Baloch Liberation Army (BLA) has claimed responsibility for a suicide bombing that allegedly killed over 30 Pakistan Coast Guard personnel. The attack reportedly targeted a coast guard camp in Jiwani, Balochistan. The BLA is identified as one of several separatist groups operating in the region.
